verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so vendor-specific GPU acceleration is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence points the other way: the docs describe local running with "no GPU" and pitch "No GPU, no server." Community reports say Needle 3 does not use the Apple GPU for inference and the GPU went unused on a Pixel even when enabled. Nothing in the pack mentions NVIDIA, AMD or other vendor-specific kernels.
